Hi Sam / Nova engineering team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great discussion. I summarized the key outcomes and a short set of next steps so we can get you unblocked on the SDK integration and the 502s you called out. Attaching the integration playbook (redwood-integration-playbook-v1.pdf).

Recap (from our call):
- Goal: embed Redwood embeddings + structured output/tool-calling for internal search/reranking.
- Primary blockers: intermittent 502s from your gateway when payloads include large arrays / tool call hints; SDK auth differences between your test harness and prod.
- Success criteria for POC: stable embeddings endpoint under peak test load (~200 concurrent calls), reliable tool-calling responses without 5xx.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Sam: please share a small failing request and associated response headers/logs (we discussed generating a minimal repro). Attach whatever you have (headers + body).
2) Engineering: confirm which SDK version you are running and whether you set x-api-key vs using the official Redwood SDK with token provider + refresh.
3) We'll run a scoped debug session tomorrow; Dylan (SE) will lead reproducer steps and a quick config checklist.

If you can send the repro payload and a representative gateway log, we’ll triage and propose a config patch. I’ll book a 30-minute debug slot for tomorrow if that works.

Thanks —

Thanks — attaching the minimal repro and one gateway log snippet (repro-payload.json). We started hitting 502s when the client sends batches with the embeddings request where the "inputs" array length > 50 or when the payload includes the structured tool_call object. We see the 502 come back after ~6s.

Example response summary from our gateway:
- status: 502
- server: nginx/1.20.1
- x-upstream-time: 6.12s
- x-request-id: nova-gw-5f8c

We tested two flows:
A) direct HTTP to Redwood hosted endpoint with x-api-key header (from our test harness) — sometimes works, sometimes 502.
B) calling through our internal API gateway (adds tracing, rate-limit) — more reliably returns 502.

We are on the SDK pinned at 0.9.1 (legacy), but were going to try 1.2.0 later today.

Logs attached: repro-payload.json, gateway-502.log

—Sam

Hi Sam — thanks for the payload and logs. I’ll lead the repro/triage. Quick thoughts before we dig in:

1) Likely causes (in order):
   - Your gateway/proxy is hitting an upstream timeout or limiting request body size -> returns 502.
   - SDK version mismatch: older SDKs sometimes use different HTTP client defaults (connection pooling, keepalive) and may trigger proxy behavior.
   - Request shaping: large arrays + tool_call metadata can change routing and model selection; if a fallback model is unavailable the runtime could produce a transient 5xx.

2) Short repro checklist (please run if convenient):
   - Reproduce with curl directly to our endpoint (bypass your gateway):
     curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n       -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n       -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n       --data-binary @repro-payload.json 
   - If that succeeds, it confirms the gateway is the differentiator.
   - If curl gets 502, collect full response headers and a raw tcpdump around the failed call.

3) Config recommendations to try now:
   - Upgrade to SDK 1.2.0 (we fixed several connection/keepalive defaults).
   - Increase client timeout to 60s for now (we’ll tune back later).
   - Set retries with exponential backoff (3 attempts) for non-idempotent calls guarded by a unique request id.
   - Turn off streaming / chunked mode for embeddings calls (prefer stable single response).

4) Debug call: I can be available tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PST to reproduce together. Please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite.

I’m attaching a quick SDK auth checklist (sdk-auth-checklist.txt) and will start a quick run against the repro payload from our side.

—Dylan
